summary: Routed ecosystem activation through SecurityExecutionEngine with semantic tool schemas, exact approval gating, EffectEnvelope preparation and rollback handle binding.
acceptance_evidence: ToolRouter exposes ecosystem.replay.verify, ecosystem.compatibility.check and ecosystem.activate semantic tool schemas.
ecosystem.activate is classified as privileged-with-human-approval and cannot prepare without an exact approval token.
Awaiting approval activation returns no EffectEnvelope and no EffectPrepared audit event.
Approved activation binds a RollbackHandle for /var/lib/agentos/ecosystem/active-set.json before controlled effect execution.
Controlled effect execution projects the activation rollback_id from the envelope.
Activation fails closed when preserved_invariants omits no-shell, exact-approval, secret-handle, source-to-sink, audit or rollback.
Policy version in activation parameters must match the approved capability lease.

commands.summary: security_execution compiled after activation rollback helper was added.
Workspace tests passed with 79 security_execution tests.

blocked_shortcuts: Denied or awaiting-approval activation has no effect envelope.
Policy packs cannot remove core safety invariants.
Rollback metadata is required before any active artifact mutation can be represented.
Raw shell, apt or host package mutation remains outside the activation path.
promotion_impact: Completes the security execution foundation needed for runtime-mediated artifact activation without giving aom or agentd direct mutation authority.
